The CAA Micro-RONI Gen 3 is a carbine conversion kit for regular Glock handguns, the Micro-RONI is designed to offer a better grip, stability and platform for many accessories. A set of magazines with capacity for 33 rounds is also included.
 Includes:
 %c[d_purple] - %c[ui_gray_2] Picattiny rails
 %c[d_purple] - %c[ui_gray_2] 33rnd extended magazine
 %c[d_purple] - %c[ui_gray_2] Compatibility: Glock 18

The CAA Micro-RONI Gen 3 is a carbine conversion kit for regular Glock handguns, the Micro-RONI is designed to offer a better grip, stability and platform for many accessories. A set of magazines with capacity for 33 rounds is also included.
 This particular kit has been expanded by mercenaries, by including a LCO Leupold Carbine Optic and a Laser Pointer Module.
 Includes:
 %c[d_purple] - %c[ui_gray_2] Picattiny rails
 %c[d_purple] - %c[ui_gray_2] 33rnd extended magazine
 %c[d_purple] - %c[ui_gray_2] LCO Leupold Carbine Optic
 %c[d_purple] - %c[ui_gray_2] LAM
 %c[d_purple] - %c[ui_gray_2] Compatibility: Glock 18
